name: Aiera
description: Access to Aiera's financial data APIs, including live events, filings, company publications, and much more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aiera to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aiera to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-pub.aiera.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aiera MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aiera lists 18 MCP tools, including get_available_indexes, get_index_constituents, get_sectors_and_subsectors, find_events, get_event, get_upcoming_events, find_equities, get_equity_summaries, find_filings, get_filing, get_available_watchlists, and get_watchlist_constituents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aiera?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aiera in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Aiera requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aiera is developed by Aiera. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
